openai/gpt-5-mini.mistake:
1) ∀x ((p_9(x) ⊕ p_0(x)) → p_10(x)) vs NL: “if either x prioritizes their wellbeing or x practices mindfulness, then x leads a balanced life.” The FOL uses exclusive-or (⊕, “but not both”), but the NL wording lacks “but not both” and is naturally read as inclusive OR in many contexts. Using ⊕ over-constrains the condition.

2) p_6(Amber) ⊕ p_7(Amber) vs NL: “making healthier choices and engaging in extreme sports are mutually exclusive behaviors.” ⊕ asserts exactly one holds (they are mutually exclusive and one of them is true). The NL phrase “mutually exclusive” usually only implies they cannot both be true (¬(p_6 ∧ p_7)), not that one must hold. Thus ⊕ is stronger than the NL statement.
